description.value:
The Aldecaldos value effective solutions. That’s why their weaponsmiths love the Uragan — it’s easy to modify out into a truly ferocious weapon that most mercs could only dream of. Smartlinking, longer range optics, comfortable controls, and better munitions all make the ‘Aero-Killer’ a favorite of Nomad convoy escorts.

Cost: 5,000eb (Luxury)

Class: EQ Rocket Launcher • Skill: Heavy Weapons • Range: Mis. Launcher

Damage: 8d6 • Capacity: 10 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: Explosive

Concealable: No

Slots: 1 • Attachments: Infrared Nightvision Scope, Sniping Scope, Rocket Long Tube, Smart Rebuild • Mods: Modular Rails

Special Features: This weapon’s laser targeting system allows it to fire Smart Rockets without requiring Targeting Scope cyberware. When dealing damage via Improved Smart Ammunition with this weapon on a vehicle, FBC, or drone, any damage die that land on a 1 are re-rolled until they result in a higher value. This weapon’s magazine can be loaded with up to 5 different types of Ammunition, with the user selecting which to use when firing this weapon. Reloading this weapon requires three Reload Actions.

Range: Mis. Launcher
Pre-installed: Infrared Nightvision Scope, Sniping Scope, Rocket Long Tube, Smart Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)
Mods: Modular Rails
Alt. fire: Explosive

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
